meta.customization: Use data-orientation and mason-separator classes to style horizontal and vertical separators.

parity.baseUi: Thin vertical matches Base UI Separator direction for decorative or semantic separator rendering, horizontal/vertical orientation, role presentation/separator choice, and data-orientation styling hooks. Gaps: richer orientation docs and layout token presets remain follow-up work.
parity.kobalte: Comparable to Kobalte Separator with Solid pass-through props and orientation metadata. Gaps: no Keystone primitive dependency yet and no shared direction/RTL provider integration needed for this simple surface.
